title: Sri Lanka Weekend Island Break: Bentota and Colombo
alt: Fishermen on stilts off the south coast of Sri Lanka
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class beach resort on the Bentota shore

activities.name: Private full day Bentota sightseeing
activities.description: The Madu Ganga boat ride, the Kosgoda turtle hatchery, the Galapatha temple and an afternoon on Bentota beach.

activities.name: Private excursion to Mirissa
activities.description: Along the southern coast to Mirissa beach and Coconut Tree Hill, with a stop at the Galle fort on the way back.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Straight from the airport to the beach with a private full day of Bentota on arrival and a private excursion to Mirissa the next day.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Historic harbourside hotel in the Colombo Fort district

activities.name: Private full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night in the Fort district with a private full day of the capital.

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: A long weekend on the island: two nights on the beach at Bentota with the turtles, the Madu Ganga and a day at Mirissa and Galle, then a last night in Colombo with a full day of the capital.
included: Included: 3 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; a private full day Bentota sightseeing tour; a private excursion to Mirissa; a private full day Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
